name: Miami International

hours.quote: All Months, All Days, All Hours

ppr.v: PPR 3 hours before every arrival on the General Aviation Center (GAC) ramp (305-876-7550); aircraft with wingspan over 78 ft may not enter the GAC ramp
ppr.quote: PPR 3 HRS PRIOR TO ALL ARRIVALS ON THE GENERAL AVIATION CENTER (GAC) RAMP 305-876-7550

max_aircraft.v: GAC ramp: wingspan up to 78 ft only; wingspans over 171 ft may not taxi on taxiway P east of U
max_aircraft.quote: ACFT WITH WINGSPAN GREATER THAN 78 FT ARE PROHIBITED FROM ENTERING THE GAC RAMP.

noise.v: all turbojets must fly the NADP-2 noise abatement departure profile from all runways; runways 8L/26R and 12/30 closed 03:00–12:00 UTC (23:00–08:00 local in summer, EDT UTC-4; 22:00–07:00 in winter, EST UTC-5) when 8R/26L and 9/27 are in use
noise.quote: ALL TBJT ACFT ARE REQD TO USE DSNT NOISE ABATEMENT DEP PROFILE (NADP-2) FROM ALL RWYS.

notes: US AIP Part 3 AD 2 Florida, HTML, read 28 Oct 2026 (amendment shown on page not stated; 29th edition effective 22 Jan 2026, Amendment 1 dated 9 Jul 2026 published). The AIP says only 'US CBP AND EAPIS AVBL.' with no hours, so customs is not recorded; the CBP KMIA fact sheet was not found because the web search budget ran out. Airport contact is listed at the Miami-Dade Aviation Department. Local-time conversion of the 0300-1200Z runway closure is mine. ft to m conversion mine (1 ft = 0.3048 m).
